import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MODUL = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_LEVEL = 33;
    static long[] arrayBits = new long[MAX_LEVEL * 2];
    static long nValInput, mValInput;

    static class MatrixStruct {
        long[][] matrixData = new long[MAX_LEVEL][MAX_LEVEL];

        public MatrixStruct multiply(MatrixStruct other) {
            MatrixStruct result = new MatrixStruct();
            for (int i = 0; i <= mValInput; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= mValInput; ++j) {
                    result.matrixData[i][j] = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= mValInput; ++k) {
                        result.matrixData[i][j] = (result.matrixData[i][j] + this.matrixData[i][k] * other.matrixData[k][j]) % MODUL;
                    }
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static int getNumber(Scanner sc) {
        int x = 0, sign = 1;
        char ch = sc.next().charAt(0);
        while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
            if (ch == '-') sign = -1;
            ch = sc.next().charAt(0);
        }
        do {
            x = x * 10 + (ch - '0');
            if (!sc.hasNext()) break;
            ch = sc.next().charAt(0);
        } while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9');
        return x * sign;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        nValInput = getNumber(sc);
        mValInput = getNumber(sc);
        long tempN = nValInput;
        int len = -1;
        while (tempN > 0) {
            len++;
            arrayBits[len] = tempN % mValInput;
            tempN /= mValInput;
        }
        len++;
        MatrixStruct answer = new MatrixStruct();
        for (int i = 0; i <= mValInput; ++i) {
            answer.matrixData[0][i] = 1;
        }
        MatrixStruct[] P = new MatrixStruct[MAX_LEVEL];
        MatrixStruct[] S = new MatrixStruct[MAX_LEVEL];
        MatrixStruct[] A = new MatrixStruct[MAX_LEVEL];
        for (int i = 0; i <= mValInput; ++i) {
            A[0] = new MatrixStruct();
            for (int j = 0; j <= mValInput; ++j) {
                A[0].matrixData[j][j] = 1;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
            A[i] = new MatrixStruct();
            for (int j = 0; j <= mValInput; ++j) {
                A[i].matrixData[j][j] = 1;
            }
            if (i == 0) {
                for (int j = 0; j < mValInput; ++j) {
                    A[i].matrixData[mValInput][mValInput] = 1;
                    for (int k = 0; k < mValInput; ++k) {
                        if (k != j) {
                            A[i].matrixData[k][k] = 1;
                            for (int l = 0; l <= mValInput; ++l) {
                                A[i].matrixData[k][l] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for (int j = 0; j < mValInput; ++j) {
                    if (j == 0) {
                        A[i] = S[i - 1][0];
                    } else {
                        A[i] = S[i - 1][j].multiply(P[i - 1][j - 1]);
                    }
                }
            }
            P[i] = new MatrixStruct();
            P[i].matrixData = new long[mValInput + 1][mValInput + 1];
            P[i] = A[i];
            for (int j = 1; j < mValInput; ++j) {
                P[i] = P[i].multiply(A[i]);
            }
            S[i] = new MatrixStruct();
            S[i].matrixData = new long[mValInput + 1][mValInput + 1];
            S[i] = A[i];
            for (int j = mValInput - 2; j >= 0; --j) {
                S[i] = A[i].multiply(S[i]);
            }
        }
        int j = 0;
        for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
            while (arrayBits[i] > 0) {
                answer = answer.multiply(A[i]);
                j++;
                if (j == mValInput) j = 0;
                arrayBits[i]--;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer.matrixData[0][(int) mValInput]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
